CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_data.field_managers_digest_iu()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'app_data', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE app_data.staff
     SET digest_opt_in = NEW.digest_opt_in, updated_at = now()
   WHERE staff_id = OLD.id;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$
